intro: Kil'hala is a jungle troll tailoring trainer stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. Skilled in working with both everyday cloth and exotic woven materials, he instructs Horde crafters looking to refine their needlework. Beyond common thread, he directs ambitious tailors north into Ashenvale to procure rare reagents like nether-lace.

p: Positioned at the bustling hub of the Crossroads, Kil'hala offers his tailoring expertise to passing travelers and Horde recruits. While much of his craft involves common spun bolts and garments fit for dry plains life, his knowledge extends into rare magical textiles. To craft truly remarkable robes, Kil'hala challenges weavers to venture into the untamed canopies of Ashenvale, where ethereal materials like nether-lace can be harvested from magical dryads.
